highlights.description: 将世界模型的目标从预测外部物理状态转变为在决策时间信息上做因果KV残差校正，并以异步System 2锚点+System 1滚动记忆的精简表述给出可操作的机制设计。
highlights.excerpt: Rather than forecasting future physical states or claiming causal identification of external scene dynamics, $W_{\theta}$ operates causally in decision-time information, conditioning strictly on the latest real KV memory anchor $z_{a
highlights.transferability: 可迁移至其他带缓存前缀条件的VLA，但需兼容缓存接口与flow velocity head
highlights.limitation: 论文自述跨架构迁移与替代动作头未测试

highlights.description: 通过配对起始的边界翻转与边界超额指标量化异步控制抖动，并给出置信区间，构成对‘边界抖动’主张的受控检验。
highlights.excerpt: Boundary excess (pp; $\to 0$ ) +0.88 −0.03 Excess change: $-0.91$ pp; 95% CI $[-1.23,-0.62]$
highlights.transferability: 配对边界指标可复用于其他异步控制器评测
highlights.limitation: 表头截断，指标定义需依赖附录

highlights.description: 明确部署检查点、种子、初始化与500个官方起始的评测配置，体现可复现的数据工艺。
highlights.excerpt: The deployed controller uses the 12k-update checkpoint trained with seed 42 from zero-residual initialization around the official frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ LIBERO weights, evaluated across 500 official LIBERO starts [ 23 ] at seed 7 after selecting the training-budget peak in Table 10 .
highlights.transferability: 配置完全绑定于LIBERO与pi0.5权重
highlights.limitation: 单一基准、单种子、单预算峰值选择

highlights.description: 发现KV重建精度与任务成功可解耦：加入动作蒸馏后原始KV误差反而升高但动作MSE与成功率更优，揭示目标函数应面向控制响应而非重建保真。
highlights.excerpt: adding action distillation via Eq. 4 in Section 3.4 cuts action MSE from 0.02018 to 0.00983 and raises success from 85.60% to 92.80% despite increasing raw KV error from 0.28461 to 0.31958
highlights.transferability: 对任何以潜在表示为中介的控制接口具有普遍提示意义
highlights.limitation: 仅单基准上的配对对比，需跨环境验证
